events.title: PWR Q1 Earnings Top Estimates on Strong Execution, 2026 View Raised
events.body: Quanta tops Q1 estimates on strong segment execution, lifting margins and backlog, and prompting management to raise its 2026 outlook.

events.title: Martin Marietta Q1 Earnings Miss Estimates, Revenues Beat, Stock Up
events.body: MLM Q1 earnings miss despite revenue growth, as strong aggregates demand is offset by rising costs and margin pressure.

events.title: VMC Q1 Earnings & Revenues Beat Estimates on Pricing and Cost Control
events.body: Did Vulcan deliver a strong Q1 beat on the back of strong aggregates-led business, pricing gains and cost control efforts?

events.title: EMCOR Q1 Earnings and Revenues Beat Estimates, Both Rise Y/Y, Stock Up
events.body: EME's shares jump after Q1 earnings and revenues beat estimates, fueled by strong demand, margin gains and a raised 2026 guidance.
